game_title: Name Tag Match – Library Tower Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in The Kingdom – Library Tower, the royal library tower: the town guard must handle rogue knights while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Name Tag Match: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing torches before they reach rogue knights.
theme: The Kingdom – Library Tower: the royal library tower
core_gameplay_loop: In Library Tower, repeat each round: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing torches before they reach rogue knights. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the town guard ahead. Then check the tag_matches value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the town gate by solving code steps involving tag_matches that move the town guard forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the town gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 4 (applied tier): Name Tag Match
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Name Tag Match' (Week 1 slot 5), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Library Tower'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tag_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue knights in Library Tower.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
